fusions.name: Wildfire Weave
fusions.desc: Throws a bolt of fire that deals 12 damage and sets the target [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds, with a 50% chance of [Cursed Channel] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Flashover
fusions.desc: Ignites every affliction on the target at once, dealing 20 damage plus 1.6 times the damage they had left to deal, then sets it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Mantle of Cinders
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are set [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Fuel for Thought
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition on an enemy, you restore 3 mana. Once every 3 seconds.
